title: Rillettes and Eggplant Tartine
description: A simple, flavorful appetizer featuring creamy rillettes and roasted eggplant, perfect for a quick snack or light lunch.
instructions: Slice the eggplant into 1/4-inch thick rounds. Place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, and sprinkle with salt.
Roast in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned.
Meanwhile, toast the sliced French bread until lightly browned.
Spread a layer of rillettes on each toasted bread slice.
Top with a roasted eggplant slice, some chopped parsley, and a sprinkle of crumbled mellow cheese.
